decisions.reason: As a component embedded in the firm’s established radiant-heating know-how, service network and in-house development routines, it remains easy to improve and commercially absorb, so retention is more likely than withdrawal.
This flagship electric infrared line fits the firm’s low-carbon direction and draws on closely related engineering and market knowledge, making continued refinement and retention highly likely.

The electric halogen infrared heater is still close enough to the core competence base to be learned from and supported, but its less central strategic role and possible overlap with priority electric lines make it more exposed than the main focus products.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater combines very strong relatedness to the firm’s existing gas-radiant expertise with a clear fit to its hydrogen-ready strategic path, so management is very likely to keep developing and marketing it.
